rationale: New switch on op.op (7 cases) but each branch is a single return of a constant-field copy over the same local helper; it is a redaction table in disguise (pure value mapping), so the exception applies.

New 4-case switch on event.type whose branches hold multi-statement behavior (seed map plus running-set mutation per variant); the chain is inline in the fold, not a registry, so the next background variant edits it.
Adds case 'notes' to an existing CLI switch on the command name whose 3+ branches each validate and call their own collaborator; a 4th variant branch widens an already growing dispatch.
Renames the stable branch to auto and edits its body; no new variant branch is added and the chain length is unchanged, so this edit does not extend a dispatch chain.
Adds else if (activeTool.type === "bucketfill") to an existing tool-type if/else chain already holding 5+ variant branches with their own canvas/cursor behavior.

The plan.kind dispatch inside the message branch grows from two arms (Message, Command) to three (Message, Skill, Command); the new Skill arm holds its own collaborators (draftsOfSkill, refuseText) inline, so a fourth plan kind must edit this block again.
Adds one kind guard (INBOX_KIND_MESSAGE) ahead of the command-kind guard: a 1 to 2 arm conditional, too early to call under the rule.
Adds an ApiKey guard in two methods: each is a 2-arm check (ApiKey vs other) used as validation before delegating, under the 3-branch floor.
authorsOf ternary becomes a 4-case switch on card.kind, but every arm is a single return of a field projection with no collaborators or I/O: pure value mapping, a table in disguise.
Nests a shell-output arm into the frame-type ternary, growing a 2-arm dispatch to 3 arms whose branches run different Redis write strategies; from here each new frame type edits this expression.
Adds typeof/Array.isArray arms to the child-resolution chain: dispatch over a closed set of JS child types in the renderer, the designated place; no new domain variant reaches it.

The new serializeBoundaryChild is a typeof/Array.isArray/isUntrustedObject chain over a closed set of JS child types, each arm a single return; a closed-set mapping in the renderer, the one place it belongs.
Adds case AgentSaid to the entry-kind switch, but the arm is a single return of a view-model literal with no collaborator or I/O: pure value mapping, a table in disguise.
Adds case 'indexDuplicate' to a switch on refusal.kind whose arms each do their own lookups, guard and message build; a new refusal kind must edit this multi-statement chain again.
closeClient branches on isFunction probes of optional adapter methods: feature detection guards on a duck-typed client, not dispatch on a variant tag.
Adds case 'mixin' to the completion-item switch, where every arm only assigns constant kind/detail fields: pure value mapping over a closed parser node-kind set.
Adds case RequestTooLarge returning a constant title/detail pair: a copy table entry, pure value mapping.
Adds case 'reconnect-requested' whose arm is one line delegating to a new named handler: the reducer's one-line-per-variant dispatch, the good outcome, not inline variant behavior.
Re-arms the element-type switch so freedraw gets its own one-line handler call; a tag-to-handler table in switch form, and no variant is added.
New hover cases each return a one-property tag object, and the added render arms are one-line dispatches to named render functions: pure mapping and a tag-to-handler table.
The new getUrlForPath switches on build format, a closed config mode with two arms, and guards routeType; a small closed-mode branch, not a growing variant dispatch.
Switch on the sec-fetch-site header whose arms return true/false constants: pure value mapping over a closed HTTP header value set.
Adds an else if on req.readableEnded, a state guard on the stream, not a branch on a variant tag.
Adds an instanceof Response arm for the message option's closed public type union (string, object, Response); a type-narrowing guard on a stable set.
Turns the op.type ternary into an if with the same two arms and adds subscribe-time logic inside one arm; no new variant branch.
Adds a third answer-kind arm (mismatch) to the controller's status/content chain, each arm setting its own status, headers and body inline; the answer union grows by editing this chain.
Frame-type ternary becomes a three-arm if whose arms are single-return series expressions: pure value mapping in a reducer step.
Adds a two-arm kind ternary (workflow-run vs PR) around a query builder; two branches only, under the three-branch floor.
Adds an Interrupted arm to the process-outcome check, but every arm is a single return of a small plain result object: pure value mapping of an outcome to a run result.
Thread scope adds a MAIN_THREAD_ONLY_KINDS set and a membership guard: the table is the good outcome and no dispatch chain grows.
Adds SignIn to a fall-through case group that shares one return expression: no variant-specific behavior is added and the arm is a pure equality comparison.
Header merge guards and typeof checks inside if branches; no dispatch on a variant tag.
Wraps revalidateTag in try/catch and returns a result object; no conditional chain is extended.
Replaces two hardcoded per-slot assignments with a slotted table plus a filter; the new slotOf is a length guard, so the change moves toward data over branching.
Rewrites isObject as early-return typeof guards with a prototype check; no variant dispatch chain.
Adds a spawnedInto helper testing a single event type inside some(); no chain grows.
Rewrites group ordering into recursion with one typeof slot check distinguishing a group key from an element: a data-shape discriminator, not a variant dispatch.
Adds disposed guards and subscription bookkeeping around the retry loop; no branch on a variant tag is added.
The extra else if tests the result value's shape (true/false/Response), a guard on outcomes, not a branch on a type tag.
Replaces a status set with retryableOf, a two-clause predicate, and adds a body-detail parser; no dispatch chain grows.
New stoppedAfterPromptOf folds events with a two-arm type check inside one loop; a small reducer, not a growing dispatch chain.
Adds case 'pdf' with template lookup, PDF rendering and archive I/O inside an existing export-kind switch that already has 3+ variant arms with their own collaborators.
Adds case 'webhook' whose branch enqueues through its own service and records a receipt, extending a channel switch whose arms each drive a different provider.
Adds case 'wallet' with its own adapter call and ledger append to a payment-method switch already holding card and bank arms.
Adds case 'azure' performing two uploads through azureClient, copied from the s3 and gcs arms: the backend variant is added by editing the storage switch.
Adds case 'fixed-width' that parses and returns rows inside an upload-format switch whose arms each carry their own format handling.
Adds case 'map' that renders SVG, renders a PDF and fills the cache inline in a report-kind switch.
Adds case 'postal' booking through postalApi and logging the booking in a carrier switch whose arms each own their API.
Grew the provider chain from password/oauth to three arms by adding a saml arm with its own assertion verification and session save, so the next provider edits this chain.
Adds case 'og' cropping, encoding and caching inline in a variant-size switch that already has several arms.
Adds a refund arm to the event-kind else-if chain that pushes ledger entries and calls notifyFinance; the arm does its own mutation and side call.
Adding a ListNode class still extends the instanceof chain in plan() with a fourth arm instead of giving each node its own render step.
Grew the importer-name chain from csv/tsv to three arms with a yaml arm holding its own parsing logic; a new importer format edits this chain.
Adds a boolean payload arm with its own JSON body and size check; the payload-type chain grows to four arms that each encode their own wire shape.
Grew the provider-type chain from two to three arms with an s3 arm computing its own headers, url and timeout.
Adds a Subscription class but prices it by extending the instanceof chain to three arms with an inline tax computation instead of a per-class price.
Grew the rule-kind chain from two to three arms with a rate arm doing its own window maths and threshold check.
Grew the channel-kind chain from two to three arms; the webhook arm computes its own attempts, label and guidance, so a new channel kind edits describe().
One new method variant edits two switches at once (serialize and validate): shotgun extension, each arm doing per-method signing or validation.
The carousel block adds an arm to both render() and measure(): the same variant edits two dispatch chains in one class.
The between filter adds an arm to both toSql() and toParams(): the same variant edits two dispatch chains in one class.
sms is added both to the previewMessage if-chain and to the sendMessage switch, each arm holding its own recipient logic and provider call.
poll is added to both build() and score() switches, so one new feed kind edits two dispatch chains with inline per-kind logic.
credit-note edits both cells() and summary() switches, so one new export kind changes two dispatch chains with its own formatting and arithmetic.
frequency is added both to the matches() if-chain and to the explain() switch: shotgun extension, each arm computing its own rate or explanation.
The slack arm is one constructor call per variant in a factory: the designated composition point, where each variant is a single line.
Adds a FACTORIES table entry (the good outcome) and mirrors it in a one-line-per-variant constructor map; arms hold no variant behavior, so the factory exception holds.
delivered adds label and colour constants in two switches over a closed order-status set: pure value mapping.
GBP adds one row of constant currency format fields: a lookup table in switch form.
heic adds one constant mime-type row: pure value mapping.
The new else if is a quantity validation rule on one line's values, not a branch on a variant tag.
The new arm tests feature flags and a partner id, a business guard rather than dispatch on a type tag.
The new arm is an age range condition, not a variant dispatch.
sun adds a day-of-week case returning a computed plan: days are the closed, stable set the exception names.
The added 3xx arm sits in a switch over HTTP status classes, the closed stable set the exception names, and each arm returns a constant classification.
tb adds one conversion row to a closed unit set: pure value mapping.
The channel switch is replaced by a handler per channel behind a lookup record: the chain is gone and a new channel adds a class and an entry.
The report-kind switch is replaced by ReportKind handlers registered in a record; the dispatch chain is removed.
The line-kind if-chain is replaced by a formatters record keyed by kind: a table replaces the conditional.
xlsx grows the format switch from one arm to two; under the three-branch floor this is too early to call.
application/json grows the media-type chain from one arm to two: too early to call.
Adds a new method whose two typeof/string guards live inside it; no existing dispatch chain is extended.
tsv grows the format switch from one arm to two: too early to call.
The new arm is a batch-size validation check, not dispatch on a variant tag.
A typeof early return for numbers in a formatter: a type narrowing with two arms, not a growing variant dispatch.
An instanceof arm inside a catch to pick the error message: error narrowing, not variant dispatch.
A typeof guard returning an empty string for non-strings: narrowing, not a dispatch chain.
The file is created whole (no before state), and the policy's gate excludes creations, so no open/closed finding applies.
Adds a name filter to a filter chain; no branch on a tag is added.
The file is created whole (no before state), so the open/closed gate excludes it even though it holds a kind chain.
The added closed-state arm makes a two-arm state guard over a small fixed state set; not a growing variant dispatch.
